_comment: Copy this to <data-dir>/extracts/fidelity/mapping.json and replace the
values with your own. Account numbers and names are personal data and
must not be committed to this repository.
asOf   - the date the export was downloaded. Reconciliations are dated
here rather than today so refreshing a stale balance does not
create - create the Wealthfolio account if no account of that name exists.
espp   - the stock plan. Its balance is cash withheld from pay, not stock.
It is still a SECURITIES account: Wealthfolio's CASH type means
'feeds spending reports', and this money never passes through a
tracked checking account, so reporting it there invents income.
zeroOut- accounts the export proves are empty. An aggregator that lost its
connection keeps reporting the last balance it saw, so an account
that has really been emptied has to be told to go to zero.
